description: Implementation of background process infrastructure for Git, including subprocess management, handshake protocols, and process control functions.

classes.name: subprocess_entry
classes.description: Represents a subprocess with command, process info, and associated data.

classes.name: child_process
classes.description: Represents a child process with control and communication channels.

methods.name: cmd2process_cmp
methods.description: Compares subprocess entries based on command string.

methods.name: subprocess_find_entry
methods.description: Finds a subprocess entry in a hashmap by command.

methods.name: subprocess_read_status
methods.description: Reads the status line from a subprocess via a file descriptor.

methods.name: subprocess_stop
methods.description: Stops and cleans up a subprocess.

methods.name: subprocess_exit_handler
methods.description: Handles subprocess exit, closing pipes and finishing command.

methods.name: subprocess_start
methods.description: Starts a new subprocess with specified command and initialization function.

methods.name: subprocess_handshake
methods.description: Performs combined version and capability handshake.
